short: A massive Soviet summer offensive that destroyed the German Army Group Centre and expelled German forces from Belarus.
full:
Launched on 22 June 1944, three years to the day after the German invasion of the Soviet Union, Operation Bagration was a masterclass in deception and concentrated firepower. While German high command expected an attack in the south, the Red Army struck precisely at the heavily fortified positions of Army Group Centre in Belarus. Using overwhelming armoured assaults and close air support, the Soviets obliterated the German defensive lines.

The offensive resulted in the almost complete destruction of Army Group Centre, costing the Wehrmacht hundreds of thousands of casualties and marking their most catastrophic defeat of the war. Within two months, Soviet forces had advanced hundreds of miles, liberating Minsk and reaching the outskirts of Warsaw and the Baltic coast. The victory permanently crippled the German military machine on the Eastern Front.
